text:
anya.marketing: FYI — coordinating a short op-ed with TechJournal to coincide with tomorrow's benchmark release. Need approval for a quoted stat and spokesperson.

olivia.pr: what's the quoted stat? need legal ok if it's in press copy.

anya.marketing: Proposed: 'our 95th percentile latency is under 200ms for 1k tokens on common GPUs.' (draft)

maria.legal: that wording could be risky. Suggest 'typically under' and include dataset link & provenance.

anya.marketing: ok change to 'typically under 200ms' — will include dataset provenance and a short appendix link.

samir.engineering: Can we provide a short technical contact for follow-ups? recommend sara.eng for quantization and runtime questions.

olivia.pr: Sara is fine. Also want to limit deep interviews to pre-scheduled slots; offer a 20-min technical briefing window.

pressbot: [automated] Note: embargoed outreach for benchmark scheduled at 08:00 PT to 16 reporters if PR triggers.

anya.marketing: Also planning a small social package synced with the op-ed. @luis.i18n can you confirm translations for EU langs by EOD?

luis.i18n: yes — machine + human review by EOD, will flag any culturally sensitive phrasing.

maria.legal: approve the 'typically under 200ms' phrasing and the op-ed plan. Keep claims conservative and factual.

olivia.pr: I'll draft the op-ed author blurb and the press email. Will wait for legal sign-off before sending to TechJournal.

anya.marketing: contingency: if the op-ed publishes early, we'll post an "editor note" and push corrected assets within 20 minutes. Everyone ok with that?

sara.eng: I'll be on standby for any technical clarifications in #eng-ml during the first hour post-publish.

support.lead: Support will monitor customer channels and prep an FAQ focused on latency claims and model variants.

olivia.pr: Good — scheduling a 30-min pre-publish sync at 07:30 PT tomorrow. Please join if assigned.

pressbot: [automated] Scheduled pre-publish reminder at 07:20 PT.

anya.marketing: thanks all. I'll upload the final op-ed draft and assets to the drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/op-ed-package

pressbot: [automated] Thread closed for scheduling. Summary: op-ed outreach pending, 16 reporters queued.
